{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for orders that were completed and had positive revenue (i.e., actually completed and not refunded)
actual_completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Count the number of such orders
num_actual_completed_orders = len(actual_completed_orders)

# Print the result
num_actual_completed_orders"}
